name: Build a landing page for my

messages.content:
That code didn't go through — they only last a minute, so it had probably run out. Here's a fresh link.

1. [Sign in with Google](https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth?access_type=offline&client_id=1071006060591-tmhssin2h21lcre235vtolojh4g403ep.apps.googleusercontent.com&code_challenge=3f8VwixXi8fNvwR1GkeU1oqseMwWhHMaceBd5UyRl9Y&code_challenge_method=S256&prompt=consent&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fantigravity.google%2Foauth-callback&response_type=code&scope=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fcloud-platform+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fuserinfo.email+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fuserinfo.profile+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fcclog+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fexperimentsandconfigs+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Faicode+openid&state=ySrDG8EOg7X1lAlKE2t-hg)
2. Copy the code Google shows you
3. Paste it here

The link is good for 60 seconds. If it runs out, send any message and you'll get a new one.

You are all set! Your Google account is connected and ready to go.

It looks like the sign-in prompt was sent into the chat, and your project is titled **"Build a landing page for my..."**

What would you like to build the landing page for? Share a few details about:
- What product, business, service, or personal portfolio it is for
- Key sections you'd like included (e.g., hero banner, features, pricing, contact form, testimonials)
- Any preferred style, color scheme, or branding

Once you let me know, I'll start building it right away!
